decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera sits close to the firm's core optoelectronic know-how and has had its own page for two years, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
The modular navigation camera is core technology with proven mission heritage, the HERA launch shows this, and the firm's in-house R&D supports further development.
The space situational awareness suite builds on the established sensor offer and fits the firm's research cooperations, though it is somewhat further from the core than the cameras.
The miniaturized LiDAR extends the firm's established docking LiDAR expertise toward smaller satellites, in line with its strategic direction, even though the website only mentions it.
The radiation-hard camera is close to core competencies and newly presented on its own page, so the firm is well placed to learn from early results.
The asteroid navigation camera builds on the firm's mission heritage and deep-space collaborations such as HERA, and absorptive capacity favors continuing it despite its limited website presence.
